claims: IEEE is the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers.
IEEE is the world's largest technical professional organization.
IEEE publishes nearly a third of the world's technical literature in its fields.
IEEE Xplore digital library has over 7 million documents.
IEEE sponsors over 2,000 conferences annually worldwide.
IEEE operates through eight technical councils.
IEEE's 39 technical societies and eight technical councils include the IEEE Computer Society.
IEEE was formed by the merger of the American Institute of Electrical Engineers (AIEE) and the Institute of Radio Engineers (IRE).
